0.en: The Difference Between Fichte's and Schelling's Systems of Philosophy (1801)
0.zh: 《费希特与谢林哲学体系的差别》（1801）

en: From the few public utterances in which one recognizes a feeling of the difference between Fichte's and Schelling's systems of philosophy, there shines out more the effort to evade this dissimilarity or to hide it from oneself than a clarity of consciousness about it.

Neither the immediate view of both systems as they lie before the public, nor among others Schelling's answer to Eschenmayer's1) idealistic objections against the philosophy of nature, has brought that dissimilarity into speech.

On the contrary, for example Reinhold2) had so little an inkling of this that rather the complete identity of both systems, once taken as known, has shifted for him his point of view on Schelling's system in this respect too.

This Reinholdian confusion is (more than the threatened — or rather already announced as having happened — revolution of philosophy through its reduction to logic) the occasion of the following treatise.
zh: 从少数公开的说法里，人们看得出对费希特体系和谢林体系的差别有一种感觉，但里面透出来的，更多的是一种想绕开这种差异、或者对自己把它藏起来的心思，而不是对这差别有清楚的意识。
无论是两个体系摆在公众面前的那种直接的样子，还是——在别的说法中——谢林对埃申迈尔1)针对自然哲学提出的观念论责难所作的答复，都没有把这种差异说出来。
恰恰相反，比如赖因霍尔德2)对这一点几乎毫无预感，倒是两个体系那被当成已知的完全同一性，把他在这一点上看谢林体系的视角也给挪歪了。
这种赖因霍尔德式的混乱（它比那场被扬言要发生的——不如说已被宣布为已经发生的——把哲学归结为逻辑的哲学革命更算得上是起因）是下面这篇论文的起因。

en: The Kantian philosophy had needed it that its spirit be separated from the letter and the purely speculative principle be lifted out of the rest, which belonged to ratiocinating reflection or could be used for it.

In the principle of the deduction of the categories this philosophy is genuine idealism, and it is this principle that Fichte has lifted out in pure and strict form and called the spirit of the Kantian philosophy.

That the things in themselves (by which nothing but the empty form of opposition is objectively expressed) are again hypostatized and posited as absolute objectivity, like the things of the dogmatist, — that the categories themselves have been made partly into resting dead compartments of the intelligence, partly into the highest principles by means of which the expression in which the absolute itself is spoken, such as for example the substance of Spinoza, can be annihilated, and thus negative ratiocination could set itself in the place of philosophizing as before, only with more pretension under the name of critical philosophy, — these circumstances lie at most in the form of the Kantian deduction of the categories, not in their principle or spirit, and if we had from Kant no other piece of his philosophy than this one, that transformation would be almost incomprehensible.

In that deduction of the forms of the understanding the principle of speculation, the identity of subject and object, is expressed most determinately; this theory of the understanding has been held over the baptism by reason — but if now Kant makes this identity itself, as reason, into the object of philosophical reflection, the identity vanishes in its own self; if the understanding had been treated with reason, then on the contrary reason is treated with understanding.
Here it becomes clear at what subordinate level the identity of subject and object had been conceived.

The identity of subject and object restricts itself to twelve or rather only nine pure activities of thought, for modality gives no truly objective determination; in it there consists essentially the non-identity of subject and object.

There remains outside the objective determinations through the categories a monstrous empirical realm of sensibility and perception, an absolute a posteriori, for which no a priori is pointed out other than a merely subjective maxim of the reflecting power of judgement; that is, non-identity is raised to an absolute fundamental proposition.

As it could not [be] otherwise, after identity, that is, the rational, had been taken away from the idea, the product of reason, and the idea had been absolutely opposed to being, — after reason had been presented as practical faculty, not as absolute identity but in infinite opposition, as the faculty of pure unity of the understanding, as it must be thought by finite thinking, that is, by the understanding.
There arises through this the contrasting result that for the understanding no absolute objective determinations are present, but on the other hand for reason they are.
zh: 康德哲学本来就需要这样：把它的精神与字面分开，把纯粹思辨的原则从其余部分里挑出来——那些部分属于推理式的反思，或者能被这种反思拿来使用。
在范畴演绎的原则里，这种哲学是真正的观念论，而正是这条原则，费希特以纯粹而严格的形式把它挑了出来，并称之为康德哲学的精神。

自在之物（用它客观上表达出来的，无非是对立的那种空洞形式）又被实体化，被设定为绝对的客观性，就像独断论者的物那样，——范畴本身一部分被做成了智性里静止的死格子，一部分被做成了最高的原则，靠这些原则，绝对者自身在其中被说出来的那个表述，比如斯宾诺莎的实体，就可以被消灭，于是否定性的推理就照样能把自己放到哲学思考的位置上，只是打着批判哲学的名义，派头更大，——这些情况顶多只在康德范畴演绎的形式里，不在它的原则或精神里；要是我们从康德那里除了这一件以外再没有他哲学的任何一块，那种转变就几乎没法理解。
在对知性形式的那次演绎里，思辨的原则，也就是主体与客体的同一性，被说得再确定不过；知性的这套理论是被理性抱着受了洗礼的——可是，当康德把这种同一性本身、把它作为理性，做成哲学反思的对象时，同一性在自身那里就消失了；如果说知性曾经是被用理性来对待的，那么反过来，现在理性是被用知性来对待的。
这里就清楚了，主体与客体的同一性当初是在一个多么低级的层次上被把握的。
主体与客体的同一性把自己限制在十二种、或者说只有九种纯粹思维活动上，因为模态并不给出真正客观的规定；在模态里本质上存在的，是主体与客体的非同一性。
在由范畴而来的客观规定之外，还剩下一个感性、知觉的庞大经验王国，一个绝对的后天性；对它能指出来的先验性，除了反思判断力的一个主观准则之外，别无其他；也就是说，非同一性被抬高成了绝对的根本命题。
既然事情不可能〔是〕别的样子：同一性，也就是理性的东西，已经从观念、从理性的产物里被拿掉，而观念又被绝对地对立于存在，——既然理性被摆成了实践的能力，不是作为绝对的同一性，而是在无限的对立中，作为纯粹知性统一的能力，就像有限思维、也就是知性必然要设想它的那样。
由此就产生出一个对比的结果：对于知性来说，并没有绝对的客观规定，而对于理性来说，却有。

en: The pure thinking of itself, the identity of subject and object, in the form I = I is principle of Fichte's system, and if one holds directly only to this principle, as in the Kantian philosophy to the transcendental principle that lies at the ground of the deduction of the categories, then one has the boldly expressed genuine principle of speculation.
But as soon as speculation steps out of the concept that it sets up of itself and forms itself into a system, it abandons itself and its principle and does not come back into the same.
It hands reason over to the understanding and passes over into the chain of the finitudes of consciousness, out of which it does not reconstruct itself again into identity and into true infinity.
The principle itself, the transcendental intuition, thereby receives the slanting position of something opposed to the manifoldness deduced from it.

The absolute of the system shows itself to philosophical reflection only in the form of its appearance, and this determinacy that is given to it through reflection, thus finitude and opposition, is not subtracted.
The principle, the subject-object, proves to be a subjective subject-object.

What is deduced from it thereby receives the form of a condition of pure consciousness, of the I = I, and pure consciousness itself the form of something conditioned by an objective infinity, the progress of time in infinitum, in which the transcendental intuition loses itself and the I does not constitute itself into absolute self-intuition, so that I = I transforms itself into the principle: I ought to be equal to I.
Reason, posited into absolute opposition and thus reduced in potency to the understanding, thereby becomes the principle of the shapes that the absolute must give itself, and of their sciences.
zh: 对自身的纯粹思维，主体与客体的同一性，在“我 = 我”（Ich = Ich）这个形式中，是费希特体系的原则；如果人直接只抓住这条原则，就像在康德哲学里只抓住那条作为范畴演绎之根据的先验原则一样，那么人就有了那个被大胆说出来的、真正的思辨原则。
可是，思辨一旦从它为自己建立起来的那个概念里走出来、把自己构成为体系，它就抛弃自身和它的原则，不再回到那里面去。
它把理性交给知性，转入意识的一连串有限性之中，却不再从这些有限性里把自己重新建构成同一性和真正的无限性。
原则本身，即先验直观，由此得到一个歪斜的位置，成了与从它演绎出来的杂多相对立的东西。
体系的绝对者只在它显现的形式中、由哲学反思把握着显现出来，而通过反思给予它的这种规定性，也就是有限性和对立，并没有被扣掉。
这条原则，即主体—客体，表明自己是一个主观的主体—客体。
从它演绎出来的东西由此获得纯粹意识、即“我 = 我”的一个条件的形式，而纯粹意识本身则获得一个由客观无限性、由时间上 in infinitum 的进展所制约的东西的形式；先验直观就在这进展里消失，而我并不把自己构成为绝对的自我直观，于是“我 = 我”就转变成这条原则：我应当与我相同。
被设定到绝对对立之中、因而被降格为知性的理性，于是就成了绝对者必须给自己采取的那些形态的原则，也成了这些形态的诸科学的原则。

en: That these two sides of Fichte's system — the one according to which it has purely set up the concept of reason and of speculation, and thus made philosophy possible, the other according to which it posits reason and pure consciousness as one and has raised reason conceived in a finite shape to the principle — that these two sides must be distinguished, must show itself as an inner necessity of the matter itself.

The external occasion is given by the need of the time, and first of all by Reinhold's contributions, swimming in this need of the time, to the survey of the condition of philosophy at the beginning of the new century, in which there has been overlooked both the side on which the Fichtean system is genuine speculation and thus philosophy, and also the side of the Schellingian system on which this differs from the Fichtean and in the philosophy of nature opposes the objective subject-object to the subjective subject-object and presents both united in something higher than the subject is.
zh: 费希特体系的这两个方面——一个方面是它纯粹地建立了理性和思辨的概念，从而让哲学成为可能；另一个方面是它把理性和纯粹意识设定为一个东西，并把在有限形态中被把握的理性抬高为原则——必须把这两个方面区别开来，这一点必定会表明为事情自身的内在必然性。
外部的起因是时代需要，首先是浮在这时代需要里的、赖因霍尔德关于新世纪初哲学状况的概述；在这篇东西里，费希特体系作为真正思辨、因而作为哲学的那一面被忽略了，谢林体系的那一面也被忽略了，即它由以与费希特体系区别开来、在自然哲学中以客观的主体—客体去对立于主观的主体—客体、并把两者在一个比主体更高的东西里统一起来加以呈现的那一面。

en: As far as the need of the time is concerned, the Fichtean philosophy has made so much sensation and epoch that even those who declare themselves against it and strive to bring their own speculative systems onto the track fall only more dimly and impurely into the principle of the Fichtean philosophy and are unable to defend themselves against it.
The nearest phenomenon that offers itself in the case of an epoch-making system is the misunderstandings and the clumsy behaviour of its opponents.

If one can say of a system that it has been well received, then a more general need of philosophy, which is unable to give birth to itself as philosophy — for with that it would have satisfied itself through the creation of a system — has turned to it with an instinct-like inclination; and the semblance of passive reception comes from the fact that inwardly there is present what the system expresses, which now everyone asserts in his scientific or living sphere.
One cannot say of the Fichtean system in this sense that it has been well received.

However much of this falls to the charge of the unphilosophical tendencies of the age, just so much is it at the same time to be taken into account, the more the understanding and utility know how to give themselves weight and limited ends know how to assert themselves, that all the more powerful is the urging of the better spirit, especially in the more unprejudiced, still youthful world.

If phenomena like the Speeches on Religion3) do not directly concern the speculative need, they and their reception, but still more the dignity that poetry and art in general are beginning, with a darker or more conscious feeling, to receive in their true scope, point to the need for a philosophy by which nature is reconciled for the mistreatment it suffers in the Kantian and Fichtean system, and reason itself is brought into an agreement with nature — not into one in which it renounces itself or would have to become an insipid imitator of nature, but an accordance through the fact that it shapes itself into nature out of inner force.
zh: 就时代需要来说，费希特哲学引起了那么大的轰动、开辟了那么一个时代，以至于那些声明反对它、并且努力把自己特有的思辨体系推上轨道的人，也只是更模糊、更不纯地掉进费希特哲学的原则里，没法抵挡它。
在一个开辟时代的体系那里，最直接出现的现象就是误解和它的对手们的笨拙举动。
如果可以说一个体系走红了，那么就是一种更普遍的哲学的需要——它自己不能把自己生成为哲学，因为那样它就会通过创造出一个体系而满足自己了——带着一种近乎本能的倾向转向了它；而被动接受的样子之所以出现，是因为内心里本来就有着这个体系所说出来的东西，而现在每个人都在自己的科学领域或生活领域里让它起作用。
就这个意思来说，不能说费希特体系走红过。
这里面有多少要算到这个时代那些非哲学的倾向的账上，同时也就有多少必须估计到：知性和有用性越是懂得给自己加重分量、有限的目的越是懂得让自己起作用，那个更好的精神的催促就越是有力，尤其是在还比较无偏见、还年轻的世界里。

如果说《论宗教》3)这类现象并不直接触及思辨的需要，那么它们以及它们被接受的情形，尤其是诗和艺术总的说来开始以其真正的范围获得的那种尊严——不管这感觉是模糊的还是自觉的——都指向对一种哲学的需要：靠这种哲学，自然为它在康德和费希特体系里所受的虐待得到和解，理性本身也被置于与自然的一致之中，——不是那种它放弃自己、或者不得不成为自然的乏味模仿者的一致，而是一种和声，靠的是它凭内在的力量把自己形成为自然。

en: As regards the general reflections with which this writing begins, about need, presupposition, fundamental propositions, etc., of philosophy, they have the fault of being general reflections, and their occasion lies in this, that with such forms as presupposition, fundamental propositions, etc. the entrance into philosophy is still always spun over and covered up, and it is therefore to a certain degree necessary to engage with them, until at some point the talk is entirely only of philosophy itself.
Some of the more interesting of these subjects will elsewhere receive a fuller elaboration.
zh: 至于这篇作品开头那些关于哲学的需要、前提、根本命题等等的一般反思，它们的毛病就在于是一般反思，而它们的缘由则在于：以诸如前提、根本命题等等这样的形式，进入哲学的门径至今仍被缠绕和遮盖，因此在一定程度上有必要去谈它们，直到有一天完全只谈哲学本身。
这些对象中比较有意思的一些，另外还会得到更详尽的展开。

9.en: Various Forms That Occur in Present-Day Philosophizing
9.zh: 当今哲学活动中出现的种种形式

10.en: The Historical View of Philosophical Systems
10.zh: 哲学体系的历史性观点

en: An age that has such a multitude of philosophical systems lying behind it as a past seems bound to arrive at that indifference which life attains after it has tried itself out in all forms; the drive to totality still expresses itself as a drive to the completeness of cognitions, when the ossified individuality no longer ventures itself into life; it seeks, through the manifoldness of what it has, to procure for itself the semblance of what it is not.

In that it converts science into a cognition, it has denied to science the living participation that science demands, has kept it at a distance and in a purely objective shape, and has kept itself undisturbed, against all claims to raise itself to universality, in its self-willed particularity.

For this kind of indifference, when it goes out of itself as far as curiosity, there is nothing more pressing than to give a newly formed philosophy a name and, just as Adam expressed his dominion over the animals by giving them names, to express dominion over a philosophy by finding a name.
In this way it is placed in the rank of cognitions.

Cognitions concern foreign objects; in the knowledge of philosophy, which was never anything other than a cognition, the totality of the inner has not moved, and indifference has completely asserted its freedom.
zh: 一个时代，如果把这么多哲学体系作为过去留在自己身后，似乎必然会达到那种无差别，即生活在一一试过一切形式之后所获得的无差别；当僵化的个体性不再敢把自己投入生活时，追求总体性的冲动就还表现为追求见闻完备的冲动；它借助自己所拥有的东西的杂多，为自己弄到它所不是的东西的假象。
当它把科学变成一种见闻时，它就拒绝了科学所要求的活的参与，让科学留在远处、留在纯粹客观的形态里，而它自己则抵住一切要上升到普遍性的要求，不受打扰地保持在它任性的特殊性中。
对于这种无差别来说，当它走出自身一直走到好奇的地步时，再没有比给一门新近成形的哲学起个名字更紧要的事了，并且就像亚当通过给动物起名来表达他对动物的统治那样，通过找到一个名字来表达对一门哲学的统治。
这样一来，它就被安置到见闻的行列里了。
见闻涉及的是外在的对象；在关于哲学的知识中——这种知识从来就只是一种见闻——内在的总体性没有动，而无差别则完全保住了它的自由。

en: No philosophical system can escape the possibility of such a reception; every one is capable of being treated historically.

As every living shape belongs at the same time to appearance, so a philosophy, as appearance, has delivered itself over to that power which can transform it into a dead opinion and from the very beginning into a past.
The living spirit that dwells in a philosophy demands, in order to unveil itself, to be born through a kindred spirit.
Before the historical conduct that, out of some interest or other, goes after cognitions of opinions, it passes by as a foreign phenomenon and does not reveal its inner being.

It can be a matter of indifference to it that it must serve to enlarge the remaining collection of mummies and the general heap of contingencies, for it has itself escaped out of the hands of the curious collecting of cognitions.

This holds fast to its standpoint, indifferent toward truth, and preserves its self-sufficiency, whether it accepts or rejects opinions or declines to decide; it can give philosophical systems no other relation to itself than that they are opinions, and such accidents as opinions can do nothing to it; it has not recognized that there is truth.
zh: 没有任何哲学体系能躲开被这样接受的可能；每一个体系都可以被历史地处理。
正如每一个活生生的形态同时也属于现象，哲学作为现象也把自己交给了那种力量，这种力量能把它变成一种死掉的见解，并且从一开始就把它变成过去。
住在一种哲学里的活的精神，为了揭示自己，要求由一种同源的精神把它生出来。
在那种出于某种兴趣去追逐对种种意见的见闻的历史做法面前，它像一种陌生的现象一样一掠而过，并不表露自己的内在。
它大可以无差别地看待这一点：自己不得不去把剩下的那堆木乃伊和一般的偶然之物堆得更大，因为它自己已经从好奇地收集见闻的手中溜走了。
这种态度死死守住自己对真理无差别的立场，保住自己的独立性，无论它是接受还是抛弃种种意见，或者不作决断；它给不了哲学体系与自己的别的什么关系，只能说它们是意见，而像意见这样的偶性对它也无可奈何；它没有认识到，真理是有的。

en: The history of philosophy, however, gains a more useful side when the drive to expand science throws itself upon it, since according to Reinhold it is supposed to serve to penetrate more deeply than ever before into the spirit of philosophy and to carry further the peculiar views of predecessors concerning the investigation of the reality of human cognition through new peculiar views; only through such a cognition of the previous preliminary attempts to solve the task of philosophy could the attempt finally truly succeed, if indeed this success is granted to mankind.4) — One sees that a representation of philosophy lies at the basis of the purpose of such an investigation, according to which philosophy would be a kind of craft that can be improved by ever newly invented tricks.

Every new invention presupposes acquaintance with the tricks already used and their purposes; but after all previous improvements the main task still remains, which Reinhold, after all this, seems to conceive in such a way that a universally valid final trick would be found, whereby the work makes itself for everyone who merely cares to become acquainted with it.

If the point were such an invention and science were a dead work of another's skill, then it would indeed have that perfectibility of which mechanical arts are capable, and at any time the philosophical systems so far would be regarded as nothing more than preliminary exercises of great minds.

But if the absolute, like its appearance, reason, is eternally one and the same (as indeed it is), then every reason that has directed itself upon itself and has recognized itself has produced a true philosophy and has solved for itself the task which, like its solution, is the same at all times.

Because in philosophy reason, which knows itself, has to do only with itself, its whole work as well as its activity lies in it itself, and with regard to the inner essence of philosophy there are neither predecessors nor successors.
zh: 但哲学史却获得一个更有用的方面，即当扩展科学的冲动扑到它身上时，因为照赖因霍尔德的说法，哲学史应当用来比以往任何时候都更深入地进入哲学的精神，并把前人在探究人类认识的实在性时所特有的那些观点，用新的特有观点继续推下去；只有通过这样一种对以往那些解决哲学任务的预习的见闻，这尝试才终于可能现实地成功——如果这种成功真的是人类命定的话。4）——人们看到，这样一种研究的目的底下垫着一个关于哲学的表象，按照这个表象，哲学会是一种手艺，靠不断新想出来的招数就能改进。
每一项新发明都以对已经用过的招数及其目的的见闻为前提；可是在以往一切改进之后，主要任务仍然留在那里，而赖因霍尔德在这一切之后似乎是这样设想它的：要找到一种普遍有效的最后一招，靠它，作品对于每个只要愿意去了解它的人就自己做成了。
如果事情只在于这样一种发明，而科学是别人技巧的死作品，那么它当然就具有机械技艺所能有的那种可完善性，而在任何时候，以往的哲学体系都只能被看作大头脑的预习，别的什么都不是。
但如果绝对者同它的现象即理性一样，是永恒同一个东西（它确实如此），那么每一个转向自身并认识了自己的理性，都产生了一种真正的哲学，都为自己解决了那个任务；这个任务同它的解决一样，在一切时代都是同一个。
因为在哲学中，认识自身的理性只同自己打交道，所以它的全部作品连同它的活动都就在它自己里面，而就哲学的内在本质来看，既没有前人也没有后人。

en: No more than of constant improvements can there be any talk of peculiar views of philosophy.
How could the rational be peculiar?
What is peculiar to a philosophy can, precisely because it is peculiar, belong only to the form of the system, not to the essence of philosophy.

If something peculiar really constituted the essence of a philosophy, then it would not be a philosophy; and if a system itself declares something peculiar to be its essence, it could nevertheless have sprung from genuine speculation, which has failed only in the attempt to express itself in the form of a science.

Whoever is caught up in a peculiarity sees in others nothing but peculiarities; if particular views are granted a place in the essence of philosophy, and if Reinhold regards that to which he has turned in recent times as a peculiar philosophy, then it is of course possible to regard, with Reinhold, all the previous ways of presenting and solving the task of philosophy as nothing but peculiarities and preliminary exercises, through which, however — because (even if we see the coasts of the blessed islands of philosophy, for which we long, covered only with the wreckage of shattered ships and no surviving vessel in their bays) we must not let go of the teleological view — the successful attempt is brought about in a preparatory way. — No less must it also be explained from the peculiarity of the form in which Fichte's philosophy has expressed itself that Fichte could say of Spinoza5) that Spinoza could not have believed in his philosophy, could not have had the full inner living conviction — and of the ancients, that it is even doubtful whether they thought the task of philosophy with consciousness.
zh: 正如谈不上不断的改进，也谈不上哲学有什么特有的观点。
理性的东西怎么会是特有的呢？
一种哲学所特有的东西，正因为它是特有的，就只能属于体系的形式，而不属于哲学的本质。
如果某种特有的东西现实地构成了一种哲学的本质，那它就不会是哲学；而如果一个体系自己把某种特有的东西说成它的本质，它仍可能出自真正的思辨，这种思辨只是在试图以科学的形式说出自己时失败了。

谁被一种特性缠住，就在别人那里只看见特性；如果特殊观点在哲学的本质里得到一席之地，而赖因霍尔德又把他近来转向的东西看作一种特有的哲学，那么当然就有可能同赖因霍尔德一起，把以往一切表述和解决哲学任务的方式都看作不过是特性和预习——但通过它们，那成功的尝试还是被准备性地带了出来，因为（即使我们看到我们渴望前往的哲学的幸福岛屿的海岸只覆盖着失事船只的残骸，在它的海湾里看不到一艘完好的船）我们也不该放弃目的论的观点。——同样，也必须从费希特哲学借以说出自己的那种形式的特性出发去解释：费希特怎么会说斯宾诺莎5）不可能相信自己的哲学、不可能有完整的内心活的信念，——又说对古人来说，连他们是否自觉地想到过哲学的任务这一点都是可疑的。

en: If here the peculiarity of the form of his own system, the whole sthenic constitution of it, produces such an utterance, then on the other hand the peculiarity of Reinholdian philosophy consists in the tendency to investigate and to ground, which busies itself far too much with peculiar philosophical views and with a historical effort concerning them.

The love of and faith in truth has raised itself to such a pure and nauseating height that it, so that the step into the temple may be properly investigated and grounded, has built a spacious forecourt, in which they, in order to spare themselves the step, keep busying themselves with analyzing and methodizing and narrating until, as a consolation for their incapacity for philosophy, they persuade themselves that the bold steps of others were nothing but preliminary exercises or confusions of spirit.
zh: 如果说在这里，自己体系形式的特性、这种体系整个强劲的性状产生了这样一种说法，那么与此相对，赖因霍尔德哲学的特性则在于那种追根究底和奠定根据的倾向，它同种种特有的哲学观点以及围绕这些观点的历史性操劳纠缠得太多了。
对真理的爱和信仰已经升高到如此纯净、如此令人作呕的高度，以致它——为了让走进圣殿的那一步得到真正的追究和奠基——造了一座宽敞的前院，在里面，它们为了省掉那一步，就长时间忙于分析、方法化和叙述，直到作为自己无力从事哲学的安慰，它们说服自己：别人那些大胆的步伐不过是预习或者精神错乱。

en: The essence of philosophy is precisely groundless for peculiarities, and in order to reach it, if the body expresses the sum of the peculiarities, it is necessary to throw oneself into it à corps perdu; for reason, which finds consciousness caught up in particularities, becomes philosophical speculation solely by raising itself to itself and entrusting itself solely to itself and to the absolute, which at the same time becomes its object.

It stakes nothing in this but finitudes of consciousness, and in order to overcome these and to construct the absolute in consciousness, it raises itself to speculation and has grasped its own grounding in itself in the groundlessness of the limitations and peculiarities.

Because speculation is the activity of the one and universal reason upon itself, it must (instead of seeing in the philosophical systems of different ages and minds only different ways and purely peculiar views), when it has freed its own view from the contingencies and limitations, find itself through the particular forms [through], — otherwise find a mere manifoldness of concepts and opinions of the understanding; and such a manifoldness is no philosophy.

The truly peculiar thing in a philosophy is the interesting individuality in which reason has organized for itself a shape out of the building material of a particular age; the particular speculative reason finds in it spirit of its spirit, flesh of its flesh, and beholds itself in it as one and the same and as another living being.
Every philosophy is complete in itself and has, like a genuine work of art, the totality in itself.

As little as the works of Apelles and Sophocles, if Raphael and Shakespeare had known them, could have appeared to these as mere preliminary exercises for themselves, but rather as a kindred power of the spirit, so little can reason behold in earlier shapings of itself only useful preliminary exercises for itself; and if Virgil regarded Homer as such a preliminary exercise for himself and his refined age, his work has for that reason remained a subsequent exercise.
zh: 哲学的本质对种种独特性恰恰是无底的，而要达到它，如果身体表达的是种种独特性的总和，那就必须 à corps perdu 地投身进去；因为理性发现意识被困在种种特殊性之中，它只有把自己提升到自身，并且只把自己托付给自己和那个同时成为它对象的绝对者，才成为哲学思辨。
它在这上面押上的不过是意识的种种有限性；而要克服这些有限性、在意识中建构绝对者，它就把自己提升到思辨，并且在种种限制和独特性的无根据状态中，已经在自身之内把握了自己的根据。
因为思辨是唯一的、普遍的理性对自身的活动，所以它（而不是在不同时代、不同头脑的哲学体系里只看到各种不同的方式和纯粹独特性的见解）在把自己的见解从种种偶然性和限制中解放出来之后，必须穿过那些特殊形式[而]找到它自己，——否则找到的只是一种知性概念和意见的杂多；而这样的杂多不是哲学。
一种哲学真正独特的东西，是那种有意思的个体性：理性在其中用某个特殊时代的建筑材料为自己组织出一个形态；特殊的思辨理性在其中找到自己精神的精神、自己血肉的血肉，它在其中把自己直观为同一个东西，又直观为另一个活的生命体。
每一种哲学都在自身内是完成了的，并且像一件真正的艺术品一样，把总体性包含在自身之内。
阿佩莱斯和索福克勒斯的作品，如果拉斐尔和莎士比亚认识它们，也不可能在他们眼里显得只是为自己做的预备练习，而是一种相近的精神力量；同样，理性在它自己早前的形态里，也不可能只看到为自己做的有用练习；而如果维吉尔把荷马看作是为他自己和他那个变得精致的时代所做的一种预备练习，那么他的作品因此也就始终只是一种后续练习。

en: If we look more closely at the particular form that a philosophy bears, we see it spring on the one hand from the living originality of the spirit, which in it has restored the torn harmony through itself and shaped it self-actively, and on the other hand from the particular form that the diremption bears, out of which the system emerges.
Diremption is the source of the need of philosophy and, as the culture of the age, the unfree, given side of the shape.
In culture, what is appearance of the absolute has isolated itself from the absolute and fixed itself as something self-subsistent.

But at the same time appearance cannot disown its origin and must set out to constitute the manifoldness of its limitations as a whole; the power of limiting, the understanding, ties to its building, which it places between man and the absolute, everything that is valuable and holy to man, secures it through all the powers of nature and of talents, and extends it into infinity.

In it the whole totality of limitations is to be found, only not the absolute itself; lost in the parts, it drives the understanding to its infinite development of manifoldness, which, while it strives to expand itself to the absolute, but endlessly produces only itself, mocks itself.

Reason reaches the absolute only by stepping out of this manifold being of parts; the firmer and more brilliant the building of the understanding is, the more restless becomes the striving of life, which is caught in it as a part, to draw itself out of it into freedom.

In that it steps into the distance as reason, the totality of limitations is at the same time annihilated, in this annihilation related to the absolute and at the same time thereby comprehended and posited as mere appearance; the diremption between the absolute and the totality of limitations has disappeared.
zh: 如果我们更仔细地看一种哲学所带的特殊形式，就会看到它一方面出自精神的活的原创性——精神在哲学中通过自身把被撕裂的和谐重新建立起来，并自发地把它塑造成形——，另一方面出自分裂所带的特殊形式，体系就是从这种形式中产生出来的。
分裂是哲学的需要之源，并且作为时代的教养，是形态那不自由的、被给予的一面。
在教养中，那作为绝对者之现象的东西，已经把自己从绝对者那里孤立出来，并把自己固定为一个独立的东西。
但现象同时不能否认自己的来源，它必定要去把它的种种限制的杂多建构为一个整体；限制的力量，即知性，把它置于人和绝对者之间的那座建筑上系上一切对人来说有价值、神圣的东西，用自然和才能的一切力量把它加固，并把它一直扩展到无限性中去。
在其中可以找到种种限制的整个总体性，唯独找不到绝对者本身；它迷失在部分之中，把知性驱向它对杂多的无限发展，而知性一边力求把自己扩展为绝对者，一边却无尽地只生产出自己，于是嘲笑它自己。
理性只有从这种杂多的部分存在中走出来，才能达到绝对者；知性的建筑越坚固、越辉煌，那个在它里面作为部分被困住的生命，就越是不安地想要从它里面抽身出来，进入自由。
当生命作为理性走向远方时，种种限制的总体性同时就被消灭了，在这种消灭中它与绝对者发生关系，并且因此同时得到概念上的把握、被设定为单纯的现象；绝对者与种种限制的总体性之间的分裂也就消失了。

en: The understanding imitates reason in absolute positing and gives itself through this form itself the semblance of reason, although the posited are in themselves opposed, hence finite; it does this with so much greater semblance when it turns the rational negating into a product and fixes it.
The infinite, insofar as it is opposed to the finite, is such a rational thing posited by the understanding; for itself, as rational, it expresses only the negating of the finite.

In that the understanding fixes it, it posits it as absolutely opposed to the finite, and the reflection that had raised itself to reason by sublating the finite has again lowered itself to the understanding by fixing the doing of reason in opposition; moreover it now makes the pretension to be rational even in this relapse. - Such opposed things, which were to count as products of reason and as absolute, the culture of different times has set up in different forms, and the understanding has toiled away at them.

The oppositions that formerly were significant under the form of spirit and matter, soul and body, faith and understanding, freedom and necessity, etc., and in more restricted spheres in yet various kinds, and that attached to themselves all the weights of human interests, have in the progress of culture passed over into the form of the oppositions of reason and sensibility, intelligence and nature [and], for the general concept, of absolute subjectivity and absolute objectivity.
zh: 知性在绝对的设定中模仿理性，并通过这种形式本身给自己理性的假象，尽管被设定者自在地是对立的东西，因而是有限的；当知性把理性的否定活动变成一个产物并把它固定下来时，它这样做所带的假象就大得多。
无限者，只要它被与有限者对立起来，就是这样一种由知性设定的理性之物；它作为理性之物，就自身而言只表达对有限者的否定。
知性把它固定下来，就把它绝对地与有限者对立起来；而那通过扬弃有限者把自己提升为理性的反思，又因为把理性的作为固定为对立而把自己降回了知性；此外它现在还要自称，即使在这种倒退里也是理性的。——这样一些本该被视为理性产物和绝对者的对立面，各个时代的教养曾以各种不同的形式树立起来，而知性则在这上面费尽了力气。
那些对立面，过去以精神和物质、灵魂和身体、信仰和知性、自由和必然性等等的形式，并且在更受限制的领域里还以各种各样的方式具有意义，把人类利益的一切分量都挂在自己身上，它们在教养的进程中已经过渡为理性与感性、智性与自然[以及]、就一般概念而言绝对主体性与绝对客观性的对立形式。

en: To sublate such oppositions that have become fixed is the sole interest of reason.

This interest of hers does not have the sense as if she set herself against opposition and limitation in general; for the necessary diremption is a factor of life, which, eternally opposing, forms itself, and the totality is possible in the highest liveliness only through restoration out of the highest separation.
Rather, reason sets itself against the absolute fixing of the diremption by the understanding, and all the more when the absolutely opposed have themselves sprung from reason.
zh: 扬弃这样一些已经固定下来的对立面，是理性唯一的关切。
理性的这种关切并不是说，它要一般地反对对立和限制；因为必然的分裂是生命的一个因素，生命在永恒地设置对立中塑造自己，而总体性只有在最高的生动性中、只有通过从最高的分离中恢复，才是可能的。
相反，理性反对知性把分裂绝对地固定下来，尤其是当那些绝对对立的东西本身就是从理性中产生出来的时候。

en: When the power of unification disappears from the life of men and the oppositions have lost their living relation and interaction and gain self-subsistence, the need of philosophy arises.

It is in this respect a contingency, but under the given diremption the necessary attempt to sublate the opposition of subjectivity and objectivity that have become fixed and to comprehend the having-become of the intellectual and real world as a becoming, its being as products as a producing.
In the infinite activity of becoming and producing, reason has united what was separated and reduced the absolute diremption to a relative one, which is conditioned by the original identity.
When and where and in what form such self-reproductions of reason appear as philosophies is contingent.
This contingency must be comprehended from the fact that the absolute posits itself as an objective totality.

The contingency is a contingency in time, insofar as the objectivity of the absolute is intuited as a progression in time; but insofar as it appears as a side-by-sideness in space, the diremption is climatic; in the form of fixed reflection, as a world of thinking and thought being, in opposition to a world of actuality, this diremption falls into the western North.
zh: 当结合的力量从人的生活中消失，对立面失去了它们活生生的关系和相互作用，并且赢得独立性的时候，哲学的需要就产生了。
就此而言它是一种偶然性，但在既定的分裂之下，它是那种必然的尝试：扬弃已经固定下来的主体性和客观性的对立，并且把智性世界和实在世界的已经生成以概念把握为一种生成，把它们的作为产物的存在把握为一种生产。
在生成和生产的无限活动中，理性把曾经分离的东西结合了起来，并把绝对的分裂降为一种相对的分裂，而这种相对的分裂是由原初的同一性所制约[的]。
理性的这种自身再生产在何时、何地、以何种形式作为哲学出现，是偶然的。
这种偶然性必须由此得到概念上的把握：绝对者把自己设定为一个客观的总体性。
这种偶然性是时间中的一种偶然性，只要绝对者的客观性被直观为时间中的一种前进；但就它作为空间中的并列而出现而言，分裂就是气候性的；在固定化的反思这一形式中，作为一个由思维着的存在者和被思维的存在者组成的世界，与一个现实性的世界相对立，这种分裂就落到西方的北方。

en: The further culture thrives, the more manifold the development of the expressions of life becomes, into which diremption can entangle itself, the greater becomes the power of diremption, the firmer its climatic sacredness, the more alien to the whole of culture and the more meaningless the strivings of life to give birth to themselves again into harmony.

Such few attempts, in relation to the whole, as have taken place against the more recent culture, and the more significant beautiful formations of the past or of foreign lands, have been able to awaken only that attention whose possibility is left over when the deeper, earnest relation of living art cannot be understood.

With the removal of the whole system of the relations of life from it, the concept of its all-encompassing connection is lost and has passed over into the concept either of superstition or of an entertaining play.

The highest aesthetic perfection, as it forms itself in a determinate religion, in which man raises himself above all diremption and in the kingdom of grace sees the freedom of the subject and the necessity of the object disappear - has been able to be energetic only up to a certain stage of culture and in general or in rabble barbarism.

Advancing culture has become divided from it and has placed it beside itself or itself beside it, and because the understanding has become certain of itself, both have thriven into a certain calm side by side, in that they separate themselves into wholly isolated territories, for each of which that which goes on in the other has no significance.
zh: 教养越往前走，生命的诸表达的发展越是杂多、分裂越可能把自己缠绕进去，分裂的力量就越大，它那种气候般的圣性就越牢固，它对教养的整体就越陌生，生命要重新把自己生成为和谐的种种努力就越没有意义。
这样一些就整体而言少数的尝试——它们曾经针对较新的教养而发生——以及过去或异邦那些更重要的美的形态，所能唤起的，只是当活生生的艺术那种更深的严肃关联无法被理解时还剩下的那一点注意。
随着生命的全部关系系统离它而去，它那种包罗一切的关联的概念也就失去了，并转入了迷信的概念，或者转入了消遣游戏的概念。
最高的审美完善，当它在一确定的宗教里成形——在这种宗教里，人超越一切分裂，在恩典的国里看见主体的自由与客体的必然性一并消失——只能在一教养的某一阶段上、并且只能在普遍的野蛮状态或群氓的野蛮状态中，是有力量的。
前进着的文化已与它分裂，把它摆在自己旁边，或把自己摆在它旁边；而因为知性已变得对自己有把握，两者就并排成长为某种平静，其方式是把自身分进完全隔绝的领域，而对其中每一个领域来说，在另一个领域里发生的事情都没有意义。

en: But the understanding can also be attacked immediately in its own territory by reason, and the attempts to destroy diremption and thereby its absoluteness through reflection itself can be understood sooner; therefore diremption, which felt itself attacked, has turned against reason with hatred and fury for so long, until the kingdom of the understanding has swung itself up to such a power, in which it can hold itself secure before reason.

But just as one is wont to say of virtue that the greatest witness for its reality is the appearance which hypocrisy borrows from it, so too can the understanding not rid itself of reason, and against the feeling of inner emptiness and against the secret fear with which limitation is plagued, it seeks to preserve itself through an appearance of reason, with which it whitewashes its particularities.

The contempt for reason shows itself most strongly not in this way, that it is freely scorned and reviled, but in this way, that limitation boasts of mastery over philosophy and of friendship with it.

Philosophy must refuse friendship with such false attempts, which dishonestly boast of the annihilation of particularities, proceed from limitation and, in order to rescue and secure such limitations, apply philosophy as a means.
zh: 但知性也可以直接在它自己的领域里受到理性的攻击，而通过反思本身去消灭分裂、从而消灭知性的绝对性的那些尝试，是更容易被理解的；所以，感到自己受到攻击的分裂，曾长久地带着仇恨和愤怒转向理性，直到知性的王国已把自己抬升到这样一种力量，在其中它可以面对理性而保自己安全。
不过，正如人们常就德性说，它的实在性的最大见证是伪善向它借来的假象，知性也同样摆脱不了理性；面对内心空无内容的感受，面对折磨着有限性的那种隐秘恐惧，它力求靠一种理性的假象来保全自己，用这假象给它的诸特殊性涂上一层粉。
对理性的蔑视表现得最强烈的地方，不在于理性被自由地鄙弃和辱骂，而在于有限性夸耀自己对哲学的掌控、夸耀自己与哲学的友谊。
哲学必须拒绝与这样一些虚假尝试的友谊：它们不诚实地夸耀对诸特殊性的消灭，从有限性出发，并且为了拯救和确保这类有限性，把哲学当作一种手段来用。

en: In the struggle of the understanding with reason, a strength belongs to the former only insofar as the latter renounces itself; the success of the struggle therefore depends on reason itself and on the genuineness of the need for the restoration of totality, out of which reason emerges.
zh: 在知性与理性的斗争中，知性只有以理性放弃自己为条件才获得一种力量；因此这场斗争的成功取决于理性自己，也取决于那种对恢复总体性的需要是否真诚——理性正是从这种需要中产生的。

en: The need of philosophy can be expressed as its presupposition, if a kind of forecourt is to be made for philosophy, which begins with itself, and in our times much has been said of an absolute presupposition.
That which one calls the presupposition of philosophy is nothing other than the expressed need.
Because the need is thereby posited for reflection, there must be two presuppositions.
zh: 哲学的需要可以被表述为它的前提——如果要为那从自身开始的哲学造出一种前庭的话；而在我们这个时代，人们已经谈了很多关于一种绝对前提的话。
人们所称的哲学的前提，不是别的，正是被说出来的需要。
因为需要由此被设定为反思的需要，所以必定有两个前提。

en: The one is the absolute itself; it is the goal that is sought; it is already present - how else could it be sought?
Reason produces it only in that it frees consciousness from the limitations; this sublating of the limitations is conditioned by the presupposed unlimitedness.
zh: 一个是绝对者本身；它是被寻求的目标；它已经现成在此——否则它怎么会被寻求呢？
理性只是通过把意识从诸限制中解放出来才产生绝对者；而对诸限制的这种扬弃，又是由被预设的无限制状态所制约的。

en: The other presupposition would be the having-stepped-forth of consciousness out of totality, the diremption into being and non-being, into concept and being, into finitude and infinity.
For the standpoint of diremption, the absolute synthesis is a beyond - the indeterminate and formless opposed to its determinacies.

The absolute is the night, and the light is younger than it, and the difference of both, as well as the stepping-forth of the light out of the night, is an absolute difference, - the nothing is the first, out of which all being, all manifoldness of the finite, has come forth.

But the task of philosophy consists in this, to unite these presuppositions, to posit being into non-being - as becoming, diremption into the absolute as its appearance, the finite into the infinite - as life.
zh: 另一个前提就会是意识从总体性中走了出来，是分裂为存在与非存在、为概念与存在、为有限性与无限性。
对分裂的立场来说，绝对综合是一个彼岸——是与它的诸规定性相对立的无规定者和无形者。
绝对者是黑夜，而光比它年轻，两者的区别以及光从黑夜中走出来是一个绝对的差别，——无是第一者，一切存在、有限者的一切杂多都是从它产生出来的。
但哲学的任务在于把这些前提统一起来：把存在设定为非存在——作为变易，把分裂设定为绝对者——作为绝对者的现象，把有限者设定为无限者——作为生命。

en: But it is inept to express the need of philosophy as a presupposition of the same, for in this way the need receives a form of reflection; this form of reflection appears as contradictory propositions, of which there will be discussion below.

It can be demanded of propositions that they justify themselves; the justification of these propositions, as presuppositions, is not yet supposed to be philosophy itself, and so the tracing-back and grounding begins before and outside of philosophy.
zh: 但把哲学的需要表述为哲学的前提，是不恰当的，因为需要由此获得一种反思的形式；这种反思的形式表现为诸矛盾命题，下文要谈到这一点。
人们可以对命题提出要求，要它们为自己作出辩护；而这些命题作为前提，其辩护还不应该是哲学本身，于是探究和论证就在哲学之前、在哲学之外开始了。

29.en: Reflection as an Instrument of Philosophizing
29.zh: 反思作为哲学思考的工具

en: The form that the need of philosophy would receive if it were to be expressed as presupposition, gives the transition from the need of philosophy to the instrument of philosophizing, of reflection as reason.
The absolute is to be constructed for consciousness, [that] is the task of philosophy; but since the producing as well as the products of reflection are only limitations, this is a contradiction.
The absolute is to be reflected, to be posited; but thereby it has not been posited, but sublated, for in that it was posited, it was limited.
The mediation of this contradiction is philosophical reflection.

It is above all to be shown in what respect reflection is capable of grasping the absolute and, in its business, as speculation, bears the necessity and possibility of being synthesized with absolute intuition and of being for itself, subjectively, just as complete as its product, the absolute constructed in consciousness, must be as conscious and unconscious at once.
zh: 哲学的需要如果被表述为前提，就会获得的那种形式，给出了从哲学的需要到哲学活动的工具、到作为理性的反思的过渡。
绝对者应该为意识而被建构，这是哲学的任务；但既然反思的生产活动以及反思的产物都只是限制，这就是一个矛盾。
绝对者应该被反思、被设定；但这样一来它就不是被设定，而是被扬弃了，因为就在它被设定的时候，它被限制了。
这一矛盾的中介就是哲学反思。
首先须表明的是：反思在什么程度上能够把握绝对者，并且在它作为思辨的事业中，带有与绝对直观综合起来的必然性和可能性，也带有为自身、主观地同样完整的必然性和可能性，就像它的产物——在意识中被建构的绝对者——必须同时既是有意识的又是无意识的那样完整。

en: Isolated reflection, as the positing of opposed terms, would be a sublating of the absolute; it is the faculty of being and of limitation.

But reflection as reason has relation to the absolute, and it is reason only through this relation; in this respect reflection annihilates itself and all being and everything limited, in that it relates them to the absolute.
But at the same time, precisely through its relation to the absolute, the limited has a subsistence.
zh: 孤立的反思，作为对立面的设定，会是对绝对者的扬弃；反思是存在和限制的能力。
但反思作为理性与绝对者有联系，反思只有通过这种联系才是理性；就此而言，反思在把存在和有限的东西与绝对者相关联时，消灭了自身以及一切存在和有限的东西。
但同时，正由于它与绝对者的联系，有限者才有一种持存。

en: Reason presents itself as the power of the negative absolute, and thereby as absolute negating, and at the same time as the power of positing the opposed objective and subjective totality.
On the one hand it raises the understanding above itself, drives it to a whole after its own fashion; it seduces it into producing an objective totality.

Every being, because it is posited, is an opposed one, a conditioned and a conditioning one; the understanding completes these its limitations by positing the opposed limitations as the conditions; these require the same completion, and its task expands into an infinite one.
Reflection seems herein merely to be of the understanding, but this guidance towards the totality of necessity is the share and the secret efficacy of reason.
In that it makes the understanding boundless, the understanding and its objective world find their downfall in this infinite wealth.

For every being that the understanding produces is a determinate one, and the determinate has an indeterminate before it and behind it, and the manifoldness of being lies between two nights, without support; it rests on nothing, for the indeterminate is nothing for the understanding and ends in nothing.

The obstinacy of the understanding is able to let the opposition of the determinate and the indeterminate, of finitude and the abandoned infinity, subsist side by side without being united, and to hold fast to being against the non-being that is equally necessary to it.

Because its essence goes towards thoroughgoing determination, while its determinate is immediately limited by an indeterminate, its positing and determining never fulfil the task; in the positing and determining that has occurred there lies itself a non-positing and an indeterminate, hence always again the task itself, to posit and to determine. - If the understanding fixes these opposed terms, the finite and the infinite, so that both are at the same time to subsist as opposed to each other, then it destroys itself; for the opposition of the finite and the infinite has the meaning that, insofar as one of them is posited, the other is sublated.
In that reason cognizes this, it has sublated the understanding itself; its positing appears to reason as a non-positing, its products as negations.

This annihilation, or the pure positing of reason without any opposing, would be, if reason is opposed to objective infinity, subjective infinity - the realm of freedom opposed to the objective world.
Because this, in this form, is itself opposed and conditioned, reason, in order to sublate the opposition absolutely, must also annihilate this in its self-subsistence.
It annihilates both in that it unites both; for they are only through the fact that they are not united.
In this union both subsist at the same time; for the opposed and hence limited is thereby related to the absolute.

But it does not subsist for itself, only insofar as it is posited in the absolute, i.e. as identity; the limited, insofar as it belongs to one of the opposed, hence relative totalities, is either necessary or free; insofar as it belongs to the synthesis of both, its limitation ceases: it is free and necessary at the same time, conscious and unconscious.
This conscious identity of the finite and of infinity, the union of both worlds, the sensible and the intellectual, the necessary and the free, in consciousness is knowledge.
Reflection as the faculty of the finite and the infinite opposed to it are synthesized in reason, whose infinity comprehends the finite within itself.
zh: 理性表现为否定的绝对者的力量，因而表现为绝对的否定，同时又表现为设定那相对立的客观总体性和主观总体性的力量。
一方面，理性把知性提升到知性自身之上，驱使它按自己的方式走向一个整体；理性诱使知性去生产一种客观的总体性。
每一种存在，由于被设定，都是对立的存在，既受条件限制又构成条件；知性通过把那些对立的规定性设定为条件，来补全它自己的这些限制；这些条件又需要同样的补全，于是知性的任务扩展为无限的任务。
反思在此显得只是知性的活动，但这种向必然性总体性的引导，却是理性的份额和隐秘的作用。
当理性使知性变得没有界限时，知性及其客观世界便在这无限的丰富中走向沉沦。
因为知性生产的每一种存在都是被规定的东西，而被规定的东西在自身之前和自身之后都有一个未被规定的东西，存在的杂多便处在两个黑夜之间，无所依持；它安放在无之上，因为未被规定的东西对知性来说就是无，并且在无中终结。
知性的固执能够使被规定者和未被规定者、有限性和被放弃的无限性之间的对立不被统一而并立并存，并使存在牢牢对抗对存在同样必要的非存在。

因为知性的本质指向彻底的规定，而它的被规定者却直接受一个未被规定者限制，所以它的设定和规定永远完成不了任务；在已经发生的设定和规定之中，本身就含有一种非设定和一个未被规定者，于是任务本身——去设定和去规定——总是一再出现。 - 知性若把这些对立面，即有限者和无限者，固定下来，使两者应当同时作为互相对立的东西持存，那么知性就毁灭了自身；因为有限者和无限者的对立意味着：只要其中一方被设定，另一方就被扬弃。
理性认识到这一点，就已经把知性本身扬弃了；知性的设定在理性看来是一种非设定，知性的产物则是种种否定。
这种消灭，或者说理性不作任何对立设定的纯粹设定，如果理性被与客观的无限性对立起来，就会是主观的无限性 - 即与客观世界相对立的自由王国。
因为这东西在这种形式中本身也是对立而受条件限制的，所以理性为了绝对地扬弃这种对立，也必须把这种东西连同它的自身独立性一起消灭。
理性把两者联合起来，也就把两者消灭了；因为两者之所以存在，只是由于它们没有被联合。
在这种联合中，两者同时持存；因为对立面因而也是有限者，就此与绝对者发生了联系。
但它并不是自为地持存，只是就它被设定在绝对者之中、即被设定为同一性而言才持存；有限者，就它属于那些对立因而相对的总体性之一而言，或者是必然的，或者是自由的；就它属于两者的综合而言，它的限制就停止了：它同时既自由又必然，既是有意识的又是无意识的。
有限者和无限性的这种有意识的同一性，这两个世界——感性的世界和智性的世界、必然的世界和自由的世界——在意识中的联合，就是知识。
作为有限者之能力的反思，以及与之相对立的无限者，都在理性中被综合，而理性的无限性把有限者包含在自身之中。

en: Insofar as reflection makes itself its own object, its highest law, which is given to it by reason and through which it becomes reason, is its annihilation; like everything, it subsists only in the absolute, but as reflection it is opposed to the absolute; in order, then, to subsist, it must give itself the law of self-destruction.

The immanent law by which it would constitute itself as absolute out of its own power would be the law of contradiction, namely that its being-posited is and remains; by this it would fix its products as absolutely opposed to the absolute, would make it an eternal law for itself to remain understanding and not to become reason, and to hold fast to its work, which in opposition to the absolute is nothing (and as limited it is opposed to the absolute).
zh: 就反思把自己当作自己的对象而言，它的最高法律——这条法律由理性给它，反思通过它才成为理性——就是它的消灭；反思像一切东西一样，只在绝对者之中持存，但作为反思，它与绝对者相对立；所以，为了持存，它必须给自己立下自我毁灭的法律。
那种使反思凭自己的力量把自己建构为绝对者的内在法律，会是矛盾的法律，也就是说：它的被设定状态存在着并保持着；反思由此把它的产物固定为与绝对者绝对对立的东西，并给自己立下永恒的法律：始终做知性而不成为理性，并固守它的作品——这作品在与绝对者的对立中是无（而作为有限的东西，它又是与绝对者相对立的）。

en: Just as reason thereby becomes something of the understanding and its infinity a subjective one, when it is placed in an opposition, so the form that reflecting expresses as thinking is capable of precisely this ambiguity and this misuse.

If thinking is not posited as the absolute activity of reason itself, for which there is absolutely no opposition, but thinking counts only as a purer reflecting, i.e. one in which the opposition is merely abstracted from, then such abstracting thinking cannot, out of the understanding, even arrive at logic, which is to comprehend reason within itself, much less at philosophy.

The essence or inner character of thinking as thinking is posited by Reinhold6) as the infinite repeatability of one and the very same as one and the very same, in one and the very same and through one and the very same, or as identity.
One could be misled by this apparent character of an identity into seeing reason in this thinking.

But through its opposition a) to an application of thinking, b) to an absolute stuffness, it becomes clear that this thinking is not the absolute identity, the identity of subject and object, which sublates both in their opposition and comprehends them within itself, but a pure identity, i.e. one that has arisen through abstraction and is conditioned by opposition - the abstract concept of the understanding of unity, one of fixed opposed terms.

Reinhold sees the error of all previous philosophy in the habit, so widespread among the philosophers of our time and so deeply rooted, of representing thinking, both in general and in its application, as something merely subjective.7) - If it were really in earnest about the identity and non-subjectivity of this thinking, Reinhold could not make any distinction at all between thinking and the application of thinking; if thinking is true identity, not something subjective, where should anything so distinct from thinking, an application, still come from, not to speak of the stuff that is postulated for the sake of the application?

If the analytic method deals with an activity, then this activity, because it is to be analysed, must appear to that method as a synthetic one, and through the analysing there now arise the members of the unity and of a manifoldness opposed to it.

What analysis presents as unity is called subjective, and as such a unity opposed to the manifold, as an abstract identity, thinking is characterized; in this way it is a purely limited thing, and its activity a lawful and rule-conforming application to a matter that is otherwise present, which cannot penetrate to knowledge.
zh: 正如理性一旦被置入一种对立之中，就由此变成知性的东西，它的无限性也变成主观的无限性，同样，反思作为思维所表达的那种形式，也恰好会陷入这种两义性和这种滥用。
如果思维不被设定为理性自身的绝对活动——对于这种活动来说根本不存在什么对立——，而只被当作一种更纯粹的反思，即这样一种反思：在其中人们只是从对立中抽象掉，那么这样一种进行抽象的思维就无法从知性中走出来而达到逻辑学（逻辑学应当以概念把理性把握在自身之内），更不用说达到哲学了。
思维作为思维的本质或内在特征，赖因霍尔德6)把它设定为同一个东西作为同一个东西、在同一个东西之中并通过同一个东西的无限重复，或者设定为同一性。
人们可能被这种表面上的同一性特征所误导，在这种思维中看到理性。
但通过把这种思维 a) 与思维的应用、b) 与一种绝对的材料性对立起来，就可以看清楚：这种思维并不是绝对同一性，不是主体和客体的同一性——这种同一性在主体和客体的对立中把两者扬弃并包含在自身之中——，而是一种纯粹的同一性，即一种通过抽象产生、并由对立所制约的同一性 - 即知性的抽象的统一概念，是被固定下来的对立面之一。
赖因霍尔德把以往一切哲学的错误，都放在我们时代的哲学家中间流传得如此之广、扎根如此之深的习惯里，即把思维本身及其应用都表象为仅仅主观的东西。7) - 如果对于这种思维的同一性和非主观性真是认真的，那么赖因霍尔德就根本不能在思维和思维的应用之间作出任何区分；如果思维是真正的同一性，不是主观的东西，那么哪里还会有某种与思维不同的东西、一种应用呢，更不用说为了应用而悬设的材料了？
如果分析方法处理一种活动，那么这种活动，由于它应当被分析，在分析方法看来就必须显得是综合的，而通过分析，统一体的各个环节以及一个与统一体相对立的杂多就产生出来了。
分析所呈现为统一体的东西，被称为主观的，而思维就被刻画为这样一种与杂多相对立的统一体，被刻画为一种抽象的同一性；这样一来，思维就是纯粹有限的东西，它的活动就是对一种本来现成的材料作合乎规律、合乎规则的应用，这种应用无法深入到知识。

en: Only insofar as reflection has a relation to the absolute is it reason, and its deed a knowing; but through this relation its work passes away, and only the relation subsists and is the single reality of cognition; therefore there is no truth of isolated reflection, of pure thinking, other than that of its annihilation.
But the absolute, because in philosophizing it is produced by reflection for consciousness, thereby becomes an objective totality, a whole of knowing, an organization of cognitions.
In this organization every part is at the same time the whole, for it subsists as relation to the absolute.

As a part that has others outside itself, it is something limited, and only through the others; isolated as limitation it is defective, and it has sense and meaning only through its connection with the whole.
Therefore there can be no talk of individual concepts for themselves, of individual cognitions as a knowing.

There can be a multitude of individual empirical cognitions; as knowing of experience they point out their justification in experience, that is, in the identity of the concept and of being, of the subject and the object.

They are precisely for that reason no scientific knowing, because they have only this justification in a limited, relative identity, and neither legitimate themselves as necessary parts of a whole of cognitions organized in consciousness, nor has the absolute identity, the relation to the absolute in them, been cognized through speculation.
zh: 只有当反思与绝对者有联系时，它才是理性，它的行动才是一种知识；但通过这种联系，它的作品消逝了，只有这联系持存着，并且是认识的唯一实在性；因此，孤立的反思、纯粹思维的真理，除了它自身被消灭这一真理之外，别无其他。
但绝对者，因为在哲学活动中它是由反思为意识生产出来的，就由此成为一个客观的总体性，一个知识的整体，一个认识的组织。
在这个组织中，每一部分同时就是整体，因为它是作为对绝对者的联系而持存的。
作为在自身之外还有别的部分的部分，它是受限的东西，并且只通过别的部分而存在；孤立起来作为限制，它就是有欠缺的，它只有通过自己与整体的联系才有意义和含义。
因此谈不上自为的单个概念，也谈不上把单个的认识当作一种知识。
可以有大量单个的经验知识；作为经验的知识，它们在经验中，也就是在概念与存在、主体与客体的同一性中，表明自己的正当性。
正因如此，它们不是科学的知识，因为它们只在一种受限的、相对的同一性中拥有这种正当性，它们既不能把自己证明为在意识中被组织起来的认识整体的必然部分，它们之中的绝对同一性、即对绝对者的联系，也没有通过思辨被认识到。

36.en: The Relation of Speculation to Sound Common Sense
36.zh: 思辨与健全常识的关系

en: Also the rational that so-called sound common sense knows consists likewise of singular things, drawn out of the absolute into consciousness, bright points that raise themselves for themselves out of the night of totality, with which man rationally helps himself through life; they are for him correct standpoints, from which he sets out and to which he returns.
zh: 所谓健全常识所知道的那些理性的东西，同样也是些个别的东西，是从绝对者那里被拉进意识的，是自为地从总体性的黑夜中升起的明亮之点，人凭着它们理性地应付着生活；它们对他说来是正确的立足点，他从这些立足点出发，又回到这些立足点。

en: But in fact man too has such confidence in their truth only because the absolute accompanies him in a feeling thereby, and this alone gives them the meaning.
As soon as one takes such truths of common sense for themselves, isolates them merely understandingly, as cognitions in general, they appear crooked and as half-truths.

Sound common sense can be brought into confusion by reflection; as soon as it engages with it, what it now expresses as a proposition for reflection claims to count for itself as a knowing, as cognition, and it has given up its power, namely to support its utterances only through the dark totality present as feeling and with this same alone to brace itself against the restless reflection.

Sound common sense does indeed express itself for reflection, but its utterances do not contain their relation to the absolute totality also for consciousness; rather this relation remains inward and unexpressed.
Speculation therefore does indeed understand sound common sense, but sound common sense does not understand the doing of speculation.
Speculation recognizes as reality of cognition only the being of cognition in the totality; everything determinate has for it reality and truth only in the cognized relation to the absolute.

It therefore also cognizes the absolute in that which lies at the ground of the utterances of sound common sense; but because for it cognition has reality only insofar as it is in the absolute, before it the cognized and known, as it is expressed for reflection and thereby has a determinate form, is at the same time annihilated.
The relative identities of sound common sense, which, just as they appear, in their limited form claim absoluteness, become contingencies for philosophical reflection.

Sound common sense cannot grasp how what is immediately certain for it is at the same time a nothing for philosophy; for in its immediate truths it feels only their relation to the absolute, but does not separate this feeling from their appearance, through which they are limitations and yet as such are also supposed to have subsistence and absolute being, but vanish before speculation.
zh: 但在现实中，人也只有对它们的真理抱有这样一种信赖，因为绝对者在此在一种情感中陪伴着他，只有这才赋予它们含义。
一旦人们把普通常识的这类真理自为地取来，仅仅以知性的方式、当作一般的认识把它们孤立起来，它们就显得歪斜，显现为半截真理。
健全常识可能被反思带入混乱；一旦它同反思打交道，它现在作为命题为反思说出来的东西，就要求自为地作为知识、作为认识有效，而它也就放弃了自己的力量，即放弃仅仅靠那黑暗的、作为情感而存在的总体性来支撑自己的说法，并且单凭这同一个总体性去顶住那游移不定的反思。
健全常识固然为反思而表达自己，但它的说法并不也为意识而包含着它们对绝对总体性的联系，这种联系反而留在内心，没有被表达出来。
因此思辨固然理解健全常识，但健全常识并不理解思辨的行动。
思辨只把认识在总体性中的存在认作认识的实在性；一切被规定的东西，对思辨来说都只有在已被认识到的对绝对者的联系中才有实在性和真理。
因此思辨也认识到那作为健全常识各种说法的根据的东西中的绝对者；但因为在思辨看来，认识只有在绝对者之中才有实在性，所以在思辨面前，那被认识到、被知道的东西，一旦像它为反思所说的那样说出来并因此具有一种规定的形式，就同时被消灭了。
健全常识的那些相对的同一性，完全像它们显现的那样，以自己受限的形式要求绝对性，在哲学反思看来就成了偶然的东西。
健全常识无法把握，为什么对它来说直接确定的东西，对哲学来说同时是一个无；因为它在自己的直接真理中只感觉到它们对绝对者的联系，却不把这种感觉同它们的显现分开，通过这种显现，它们是限制，而且作为限制竟然也应当有持存和绝对的存在，但在思辨面前却消失了。

en: But not only can sound common sense not understand speculation; it must also hate it when it learns of it, and, if it is not in the complete indifference of security, abhor and persecute it.

For just as for sound common sense the identity of the essence and of the contingent in its utterances is absolute, and it cannot separate the limits of appearance from the absolute, so too that which it separates in its consciousness is absolutely opposed, and what it cognizes as limited it cannot unite with the unlimited in consciousness; they are indeed identical in it, but this identity is and remains something inward, a feeling, something uncognized and something unexpressed.
As soon as it is reminded of the limited and this is posited into consciousness, for this consciousness the unlimited is absolutely opposed to the limited.

This relation or reference of limitedness to the absolute, in which relation only the opposition is present in consciousness, while as regards the identity there is a complete unconsciousness, is called faith.

Faith does not express the synthetic element of feeling or of intuition; it is a relation of reflection to the absolute, which in this relation is indeed reason and indeed annihilates itself as a separating and a separated thing, as well as its products - an individual consciousness - but has still retained the form of separation.

The immediate certainty of faith, of which as the last and highest of consciousness so much has been spoken, is nothing but identity itself, reason, which however does not cognize itself, but is accompanied by the consciousness of opposition.

But speculation raises to consciousness the identity that is unconscious to sound common sense, or it constructs into conscious identity the necessarily opposed in the consciousness of the ordinary understanding, and this unification of what is separated in faith is an abomination to it.
Because the holy and the divine in its consciousness subsist only as object, it sees in the sublated opposition, in the identity for consciousness, only destruction of the divine.
zh: 但健全常识不仅不能理解思辨，一旦它听说思辨，还必定憎恨思辨，并且，如果它不处在安全所具有的完全无差别之中，还必定厌恶并迫害思辨。
因为，正如对健全常识来说，它的说法中本质的东西与偶然的东西的同一性是绝对的，它不能把显现的界限同绝对者分开，同样，它在自己意识中分离开来的东西也是绝对对立的，而它认识到为受限的东西，它不能在意识中同不受限的东西结合起来；两者在它之中固然是同一的，但这种同一性是并且始终是一种内在的东西，一种情感，一种未被认识到的东西，一种未被说出来的东西。
一旦它被提醒到受限的东西，而这东西被设定进意识，那么对这种意识来说，不受限的东西就与受限的东西绝对对立。
受限性对绝对者的这种关系或联系，在这种联系中，意识里只存在对立，而对于同一性却是一片完全的无意识，这就叫做信仰。
信仰并不表达情感或直观中的综合的东西；它是反思对绝对者的一种关系，反思在这种关系中固然是理性，并且固然把自己作为一个进行分离的东西和一个被分离的东西、以及把自己的产物——一个个体意识——消灭掉，但仍然保留了分离的形式。
信仰的直接确定性，作为意识的最末和最高者，人们已经谈得那么多，它无非就是同一性本身，就是理性，但理性并不认识自己，而是被对立的意识伴随着。
但思辨把健全常识所无意识的那种同一性提升到意识，或者说，它把普通知性意识中必然对立的东西建构为有意识的同一性，而这种对信仰中分离之物的统一，在健全常识看来是可憎的事。
因为神圣的东西和神性的东西在它的意识中只作为客体而存在，所以它在被扬弃的对立中、在为意识而存在的同一性中，只看到对神性的东西的毁灭。

en: But the common human understanding, in particular, must see nothing but annihilation in those philosophical systems which satisfy the demand of conscious identity in such a sublation of diremption, whereby one of the opposed terms, especially when such a term is otherwise fixed by the culture of the time, is raised to the absolute and the other is annihilated.
Here speculation as philosophy has indeed sublated the opposition, but as system it has raised to the absolute something that is limited according to its ordinary, familiar form.

The only side that comes into consideration here, namely the speculative side, is not present at all for the common human understanding; from this speculative side the limited is something wholly other than it appears to the common human understanding; for, in that it has been raised to the absolute, it is no longer this limited thing.

The matter of the materialist or the I of the idealist - the former is no longer the dead matter that has a life for opposition and formation, the latter no longer the empirical consciousness which, as a limited one, must posit an infinite outside itself.

The question belongs to philosophy whether the system has truly purified from all finitude the finite appearance that it heightened into the infinite, - whether speculation, in its greatest distance from the common human understanding and from the latter's fixing of opposed terms, has not succumbed to the fate of its time, that of having posited absolutely a form of the absolute, and thus something that in its essence is opposed.

If speculation has truly freed from all forms of appearance the finite that it made infinite, then it is the name, first of all, at which the common human understanding here takes offense, when it otherwise takes no notice of the speculative business.

If speculation heightens the finite to the infinite only in deed, and thereby annihilates it - and matter and the I, insofar as they are supposed to comprise the totality, are no longer I, no longer matter -, then the last act of philosophical reflection is indeed missing, namely consciousness of its annihilation; and even if, notwithstanding this annihilation that has happened in deed, the absolute of the system has still retained a determinate form, at least the genuinely speculative tendency cannot be mistaken, though of it the common human understanding understands nothing.

In that he sees not even the philosophical principle, that of sublating diremption, but only the systematic principle, and finds one of the opposed raised to the absolute and the other annihilated, there was on his side still an advantage with respect to diremption; in him as well as in the system an absolute opposition is present, but he had after all the completeness of the opposition and is doubly vexed. - Otherwise, such a philosophical system, to which the defect clings of raising to the absolute something that from some side is still opposed, has besides its philosophical side a further advantage and merit, of which the common understanding not only comprehends nothing but which it must also detest: the advantage of having, by raising a finite thing to an infinite principle, struck down at one blow the whole mass of finite things that hangs on the opposed principle; the merit, in respect of culture, of having made diremption all the harder and thereby increased all the more the need of unification in the totality.
zh: 但普通人的知性尤其必定在那些哲学体系中只看到毁灭：这些体系以一种这样的对分裂的扬弃来满足有意识的同一性的要求，靠这种扬弃，对立面中的一个——尤其当这样一个对立面另外还被时代的教养固定下来时——被提升为绝对者，而另一个则被毁灭。
在这里，思辨作为哲学确实扬弃了对立，但作为体系，它却把某种按其通常的、已知的形式来说是受限制的东西提升为了绝对者。
在此唯一被纳入考虑的那一面，即思辨的一面，对普通人的知性来说根本不存在；从这思辨的一面看，受限制的东西完全是另一回事，与它在普通人的知性面前所显现的不同；因为它被提升为绝对者，正是由于这一点，它不再是这个受限制的东西了。
唯物论者的物质或观念论者的我：前者不再是那种死去的物质，它有一个生命，用来进行对立和形成；后者不再是那经验的意识，这种意识作为受限制的东西，必须在自身之外设定一个无限者。
这个问题属于哲学：体系是否真的把被它抬高为无限者的有限显现从一切有限性中净化出来了；——思辨在它最远离普通人的知性、最远离后者对对立面的固定时，是否没有屈从于它那个时代的命运，即把绝对者的一种形式、从而把某种按其本质来说是对立的东西绝对地设定了。
如果思辨现实地把被它弄成无限者的有限者从显现的一切形式中解放了出来，那么在这里，普通人的知性首先碰到的就是名称，只要它平时对思辨的事务根本不予理会。
如果思辨只是在行动上把有限者抬高为无限者并由此毁灭了它——而物质、我，就它们应当包含总体性而言，就不再是我、不再是物质——，那么哲学反思的最后一个行动确实还缺失，即对这种毁灭的意识；而且，尽管有这场在行动上已经发生的毁灭，体系的绝对者还保留着一个特定的形式，至少那种真正思辨的倾向是不容认错的，只不过普通人的知性对它一点也弄不懂。

由于他在这些体系里连那条哲学的原则，即扬弃分裂的原则，都看不到，而只看到那条体系的原则，发现对立面中的一个被提升为绝对者、另一个被毁灭，所以在他这一边，就分裂而言倒还有一种优势；在他那里和在体系里一样，都存在着一种绝对的对立，但他毕竟拥有对立的完整性，于是他就加倍地恼火。——此外，这样一个带有缺陷、即把某种从某个方面来说还是对立的东西提升为绝对者的哲学体系，除了它的哲学方面之外，还另有一重优势和一份功绩，对此普通知性不仅一点也不理解，而且必定还会厌恶：这优势就是，通过把一个有限者提升为无限的原则，一举把挂在相反原则上的那整整一大堆有限者打了下去；这功绩就是，就教养而言，它把分裂弄得越加坚硬，也就把在总体性中统一的需要增强得越多。

en: The stubbornness of sound common sense, which by the force of its inertia keeps the unconscious secure in its original heaviness and in its opposition to consciousness, and keeps matter secure against the difference that light brings into it only in order to construct it again at a higher potency into synthesis - this stubbornness presumably requires under northern climates a longer period of time, in order to be overcome for the present only so far that atomic matter itself becomes more manifold, that inertia is first of all set into a movement on its own ground through a more manifold combining and decomposing of it and through the greater quantity of fixed atoms thereby produced, so that the human understanding in its understanding activity and knowledge becomes ever more confused, until it makes itself capable of enduring the sublation of this confusion and of the opposition itself.
zh: 健全常识的顽固——它凭着自己惰性的力量，把无意识的东西在其原初的沉重和与意识的对立中保持为安全的，把物质在差别面前保持为安全的，而光只是因此才把差别带入物质，为的是在一个更高的级次上把它重新建构为综合——在北方气候下想必需要一个更长的时间段，才能眼下只被克服到这样的程度：原子式的物质本身变得更加杂多，惰性首先通过对其更杂多的组合与分解、并通过由此产生的更多固定原子，被置于一种在其自身地面上的运动之中，以致普通人的知性在其知性的忙碌和知识中越来越混乱，直到它使自己有能力承受这种混乱以及对立本身的扬弃。

en: If for sound common sense only the annihilating side of speculation appears, then this annihilating too does not appear to it in its whole extent.

If it could grasp this extent, it would not hold speculation to be its adversary; for speculation, in its highest synthesis of the conscious and the unconscious, also demands the annihilation of consciousness itself, and reason thereby sinks its reflection of absolute identity, and its knowledge, and itself into its own abyss; and in this night of mere reflection and of ratiocinating understanding, which is the noon of life, the two can meet.
zh: 如果对健全常识来说，思辨显现出来的只有毁灭的那一面，那么这种毁灭在它看来也没有以其全部范围显现出来。
如果它能够把握这个范围，它就不会把思辨当作自己的对手；因为思辨在其对有意识的东西和无意识的东西的最高综合中，也要求意识自身的毁灭，而理性由此把它对绝对同一性的反思、把它的知识以及它自己都沉入自己的深渊；在这片单纯反思和推论的知性的黑夜中——这黑夜是生命的正午——，两者才能相遇。
